query($id:ID!, $after:String) { node(id:$id) { ... on PullRequest { comments: comments(first:100, after:$after) { pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{ authorAssociation body } } } } }

query($id:ID!, $after:String) { node(id:$id) { ... on StatusCheckRollup { contexts: contexts(first:100, after:$after) { pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{ __typename ... on CheckRun{name status conclusion} ... on StatusContext{context state} } } } } }
